svg.aria-label: PneumaSpace: stateful web apps on one machine you own. A grid of hundreds of apps, most of them asleep; now and then one wakes on a request, turns orange, then green, and goes back to sleep, while static hits flash blue without waking anything.
svg.title: PneumaSpace
svg.text: Stateful web apps on one machine you own.
An app declares what it needs. The platform provides it,
wakes the app on demand and lets it sleep when idle.
